age.evidence: Adult male and female C57BL/6J ... were used in this study.

sex.evidence: Adult male and female C57BL/6J (#000664), Ai9 mice (#007909), and Thy1-GFP-M mice were from Jackson Labs

dosing.doses_raw: 0.3 mg/kg LSD (behavioral); 0.5 mg/kg LSD for 5 consecutive days (downregulation)
dosing.evidence: vehicle was composed of N,N-dimethyllacetamide (final volume 0.5%) ... brought to volume with 5% 2-hydroxypropoyl-β-cyclodextrin ... 0.3 mg/kg LSD ... C57 and Htr2a EGFP-CreERT2 mice were treated (i.p.) with vehicle or 0.5 mg/kg LSD for 5 days.

group_housing.evidence: Mice were housed 3-5 per cage in a temperature- and relative humidity-controlled room

assays.assay_description: Open field (21 x 21 x 30 cm) under 180 lux; 30 min baseline followed by 90 min post-injection recording. Locomotor activity (distance traveled), rearing (vertical beam-breaks), and stereotypical activities (repetitive beam-breaks <1 sec) monitored automatically by beam-breaks in 5-min segments.

application_type.evidence: injected (i.p.) with the vehicle, 0.3 mg/kg LSD, 1 mg/kg DOI, or 1 mg/kg psilocin

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were placed into the open field for 30 min to collect baseline activities (baseline data is collected, not habituation-without-data).

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice freely moved in the open field arena.

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the open field arena during recording.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the open field arena during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: returned immediately to the open field for 90 min

sample_size.evidence: Sample sizes per group not reported in main text.

outcomes.summary: DOI increased locomotion, rearing, and stereotypy; LSD increased rearing and stereotypy; psilocin did not significantly affect these motor measures relative to vehicle. Baseline locomotor, rearing, and stereotypical activities were higher overall in Htr2a EGFP-CreERT2 than in C57 mice.
outcomes.statistics: Locomotion DOI vs vehicle p≤0.031; Rearing LSD/DOI p≤0.001; Stereotypy DOI p=0.035; baseline genotype p≤0.004
outcomes.evidence: Locomotor activities were increased overall in both genotypes by DOI relative to vehicle (p-values≤0.031)... only LSD and DOI augmented overall rearing (p-values≤0.001), while only DOI increased stereotypy (p=0.035)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Locomotor activity (distance traveled), rearing (vertical beam-breaks), and stereotypical activities (repetitive beam-breaks)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: baseline activities were collected in 5-min blocks over 30 min and post-injection responses were followed over the next 90 min ... monitored in 5-min segments

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotion, rearing, and stereotypy beam-breaks are not natural ethological behaviours.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Motor activities assessed automatically by beam-breaks (Fusion Versamax).

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter in open field (definitionally absent).

E3_bedding.evidence: Bare floor of open field arena.

E6_spatial.evidence: Open field is a single open arena.

E7_social_context.evidence: Only the focal mouse was present.

D1_continuity.evidence: Baseline (30 min) followed by post-injection (90 min) was one continuous session in the same apparatus.

D2_session_duration.evidence: 30 min baseline + 90 min post-injection = 120 min total continuous recording

D3_recording_days.evidence: All open-field recording done on a single day per animal.

D4_baseline.evidence: Mice were placed into the open field for 30 min to collect baseline activities

D6_circadian.evidence: Total session ~2 h, well under 6 h.

assays.assay_name: Head Twitch Response (with grooming and retrograde walking)
assays.assay_description: Head twitches, grooming duration, and retrograde walking events filmed over 30 min during the open field session following drug administration. HTRs scored manually by blinded observers; grooming and retrograde walking scored using TopScan (CleverSys).

application_type.evidence: injected (i.p.) with the vehicle, 0.3 mg/kg LSD, 1 mg/kg DOI, or 1 mg/kg psilocin

setup_habituation.evidence: 30-min baseline collected in same apparatus (data collected, not habituation).

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were freely moving in the open field.

food_restriction.evidence: No food in open field arena.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in open field arena.

time_to_assay.evidence: filmed over 30 min during the open field studies following administration of drugs

outcomes.summary: LSD, DOI, and psilocin all increased HTRs vs vehicle; DOI > LSD or psilocin in C57. LSD and DOI prolonged grooming in C57 while psilocin reduced grooming. LSD and DOI increased retrograde walking events; no genotype difference for retrograde walking.
outcomes.statistics: HTR all psychedelics vs vehicle p<0.001; DOI vs LSD/psilocin p≤0.043; LSD vs psilocin p=0.026; grooming p-values<0.001; retrograde walking p-values<0.001
outcomes.evidence: LSD, DOI, and psilocin stimulated more head twitch responses (HTRs) in the C57 and Htr2a EGFP-CreERT2 mice relative to the vehicle controls (p-values<0.001) ... both LSD and DOI stimulated grooming for longer periods ... both LSD and DOI stimulated [retrograde walking] to greater extents than psilocin- and vehicle-treated mice (p-values<0.001).

B1_num_measures.evidence: HTR count, grooming duration, retrograde walking events

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Reported as totals over 30 min, no within-session time-course for these measures.

B4_ethological.evidence: Grooming duration was scored — a natural ethological behaviour.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: HTRs scored by hand; grooming/retrograde walking scored using TopScan (CleverSys) which is position-tracking, on the SCORE-0 list.

D1_continuity.evidence: 30 min video recording over single session.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline for HTR/grooming/retrograde walking reported.

D5_followup.evidence: No follow-up recording ≥24 h after drug.

assays.assay_description: PPI of acoustic startle in SR-LAB apparatus. 42 trials (6 null + 18 pulse-alone + 18 prepulse-pulse). Drug administered i.p., mice placed in chambers, habituated to 64 dB white noise, testing began 10 min later. %PPI, startle magnitude, and null activity measured.

application_type.evidence: Mice received (i.p.) the vehicle, 0.3 mg/kg LSD, 1 mg/kg DOI, or 1 mg/kg psilocin

setup_habituation.evidence: Following habituation to a white-noise background (64 dB), testing began 10 min later.

setup_restrain.evidence: SR-LAB startle chambers use small enclosures/holders restraining the animal during recording.

outcomes.summary: All three psychedelics (LSD, DOI, psilocin) disrupted PPI relative to vehicle in both C57 and Htr2a EGFP-CreERT2 mice. PPI was lower overall in C57 than in knock-in mice. Null activities were higher in knock-in mice; startle responses differed by genotype and treatment.
outcomes.statistics: PPI genotype p<0.001; all hallucinogens vs vehicle p<0.001
outcomes.evidence: within genotypes all three hallucinogens disrupted PPI relative to vehicle (p-values<0.001)

B4_ethological.evidence: Startle magnitude/PPI are reflex measures, not ethological.

B6_cognitive.evidence: PPI is sensorimotor gating, no learning.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: SR-LAB startle system records force transducer output, not behavioural classification.

D1_continuity.evidence: Each test composed of 42 trials in one session.

D2_session_duration.evidence: 42 brief trials following 10-min habituation; session duration not explicitly stated but trial-based PPI sessions are typically <15 min.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline PPI session reported.

judge_notes: Merged candidate gptoss's separate Open Field Locomotion, Rearing, and Stereotypy entries into a single Open Field Test assay — these are different measures from the same apparatus/protocol, scored as 1 assay per rubric (B1 captures multiple measures).

Merged candidate gptoss's separate HTR, Grooming, and Retrograde Walking entries into a single video-scored open-field-during-recording assay, since they share the same 30-min video recording during the open field session and the same scoring protocol (B1=2-3, B4=Yes due to grooming).

Kept Open Field and HTR/grooming as separate assays because B/E/D rubric treats different behavioural domains in the same apparatus as separate assays, and the HTR/grooming measures used video scoring rather than beam-break data.
PPI: set setup_restrain=yes per rubric guidance (PPI startle chambers with body-restraint tubes count as restraint).
D2 for PPI scored 0 (<15 min) with low confidence — exact session duration not stated but 42-trial PPI sessions are typically brief; flagged accordingly.
Dose schedule for LSD set to 'multiple' because behavioural studies used a single 0.3 mg/kg dose (acute) while the downregulation experiment used 0.5 mg/kg × 5 days (repeated).
Vehicle inferred as 2-hydroxypropyl-β-cyclodextrin (cyclodextrin) since paper explicitly states this was the vehicle for behavioral drugs.
